parameters.query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_log (id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), actor_type text NOT NULL, actor_id text, action text NOT NULL, entity text, entity_id text, workflow text, details jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS audit_log_entity_idx ON audit_log (entity, entity_id); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS audit_log_at_idx ON audit_log (at DESC); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks (id serial PRIMARY KEY, title text NOT NULL, description text, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open','in_progress','waiting_approval','waiting_owner','done','cancelled')), priority text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (priority IN ('low','normal','high','urgent')), assigned_to text, created_by text, due_at timestamptz, related_entity text, related_id text, result jsonb, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS tasks_status_idx ON tasks (status); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS approvals (id serial PRIMARY KEY, task_id int REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, request_type text NOT NULL, summary text NOT NULL, details jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, amount_bhd numeric, requested_by text NOT NULL, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','rejected','changes_requested','expired')), decided_by text, decided_at timestamptz, decision_note text, channel text, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), expires_at timestamptz); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS approvals_status_idx ON approvals (status); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_usage (id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), workflow text, agent text, model text, tokens_in int, tokens_out int, cost_usd numeric, task_id int REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE SET NULL); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ai_usage_at_idx ON ai_usage (at DESC); SELECT (SELECT json_agg(table_name ORDER BY table_name) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name IN ('audit_log','tasks','approvals','ai_usage')) AS created;
